usedFor: LiveChat holds your customer conversations, and Google Sheets logs them through “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A finished chat is a complete record, so one row can log it for later review.

watchOut: “Chat Changed” in LiveChat fires when a chat's tag list changes, not when a message arrives.
